Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Karan - 34 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Neeta - 30 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Shalini - 60 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Vikram - 66 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Neeta stands in the kitchen. Karan and Shalini stand near her.]

Shalini: "Today feels like a good day."

[Neeta rolls out rotis on the board.]

Neeta: "Exactly right."

[Neeta stirs the dal in the pot.]

Karan: "Neeta, listen!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Karan stands on the road. Vikram stands near him.]

Karan: "Dad, look over here."

[Karan's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Karan: "One more time!"

[Karan's car crashes into a pole.]

Karan: "Dad, listen!"

[A dog runs in front of Karan's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Karan: "Oh wow!"

[Karan loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Karan: "Okay, Dad."

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Karan stands by the road. Shalini, Vikram and Neeta stand near him.]

Shalini: "What a nice place."

[Karan rides his motorbike to the market.]

Karan: "Hmm, I see."

[Karan starts his scooter and rides off.]

Karan: "What next?"

[Karan drives the car to the office.]

Neeta (gently): "Exactly right."

[Karan gets out of the car.]

Shalini: "Hmm, I see."

[Karan rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Karan: "Mom, listen!"

[Karan takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Shalini (softly): "That's great!"

Scene 4: The road - Day

Neeta: "So, here we are!"

[Karan rides his motorbike to the market.]

Shalini: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Karan starts his scooter and rides off.]

Karan (happily): "How beautiful!"

[Karan drives the car to the office.]

Karan: "Exactly right."

[Karan gets out of the car.]

Neeta: "Really?"

[Karan rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Karan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Karan takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Shalini: "What a day to remember!"
